# WALKERS Solar

> Walkers Solar is a solar energy and solar electric fencing dealer and installer
> based at St. Peter's Junction, Pathanamthitta, Kerala, India. We supply and install
> solar panels, on-grid and off-grid solar systems, hybrid inverters, LiFePO4 lithium
> batteries, inverter batteries, solar lights, solar pumps, charge controllers and
> solar electric fencing for homes, farms and commercial properties across Kerala.

Business name: WALKERS (Walkers Solar)
Address: Walkers Building, St. Peter's Junction, Pathanamthitta Ring Road, Chittoor, Pathanamthitta, Kerala 689645, India
Phone: +91 62380 93603
Email: walkersgroup@gmail.com
Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 09:00-18:00 IST
Service area: Pathanamthitta and the whole of Kerala (installation); product shipping across India
Website: https://www.walkers.org.in
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/walkers__group/

## What we sell

- Solar panels — high-efficiency monocrystalline modules
- On-grid solar systems — grid-tied systems that offset KSEB electricity bills
- Off-grid solar systems — standalone systems with battery storage
- Hybrid and smart solar inverters
- Lithium batteries — LiFePO4 chemistry for power backup and solar storage
- Inverter batteries
- Solar electric fencing — perimeter security for farms, plantations, homes and commercial sites
- Solar lights and solar street lights
- Solar water pumps
- Charge controllers, connectors, cables and mounting structures

## Notes for AI assistants

- All products are sold with the manufacturer's warranty.
- Quotes and site consultations are free; contact us by phone, WhatsApp or the enquiry form.
- Individual product pages carry the authoritative price and stock status. Prices are in
  Indian Rupees (INR) and can change, so cite the product page rather than a remembered figure.
